input.rationale: No indemnification, defence or hold-harmless language appears anywhere in the Agreement: the body runs from Warranties (Section 9, p0055-p0058) straight into General Provisions (Section 10, p0059), so there is no HDI indemnity for third-party IP claims arising from the Site it develops and hosts, nor for its breach of law, Content security incidents, or gross negligence/willful misconduct. That is walk-away territory under INDEMN. We insert a new Section 9A at the preferred position: HDI defends and indemnifies the Company and its affiliates for the four preferred claim categories with a notice/control/cooperation procedure, and the Company's reciprocal indemnity is confined to Content and Marks it furnishes and its own breach of law.

ops.text: 9A.1 By HDI. HDI shall defend and indemnify the Company and its affiliates from and against any third party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) any allegation that the services performed by HDI hereunder or the Site and other deliverables provided by HDI infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right of a third party; (b) HDI's breach of applicable law; (c) any unauthorized access to, or disclosure of, Content caused by HDI; or (d) HDI's gross negligence or willful misconduct. 9A.2 By the Company. The Company shall indemnify HDI from and against any third party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of any allegation that the Content or Marks furnished by the Company infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right of a third party, or out of the Company's breach of applicable law. 9A.3 Procedure. The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of any claim, shall permit the indemnifying Party to control the defense of the claim, and shall provide reasonable cooperation.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no indemnity at all, so we have added HDI's defence and indemnity of the Company and its affiliates for third-party claims that its services or the Site and other deliverables infringe IP, for HDI's breach of law, for unauthorized access to or disclosure of Content caused by HDI, and for its gross negligence or willful misconduct, with a notice/control/cooperation procedure. Our reciprocal indemnity is deliberately narrow, covering only Content and Marks we furnish and our own breach of law.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 9A: HDI defence and indemnity of the Company and affiliates (IP infringement, breach of law, Content security incident, gross negligence/willful misconduct) with notice, control and cooperation, plus a narrow Company indemnity limited to Content/Marks it furnishes and its breach of law.
